settings.editor: Driving Lessons & Packages

ICBC-certified lessons for every BC licence class: Class 7 for new drivers, Class 5 road test preparation, Class 4 commercial training, plus highway and refresher lessons across Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody and North Vancouver.
Every BC licence class is a different test with different habits to build. Pick the one you're working toward.
Just passed your knowledge test, or driving on an N? We'll take you from your first time behind the wheel through to your Class 7 road test, at whatever pace suits you.
Ready to move off your N and get your full licence? Focused lessons that sharpen the skills the Class 5 road test actually looks at.
Driving for work? Class 4 training for taxi, ride-hailing and small-bus drivers, paired with our free ICBC Class 4 knowledge test practice exam.
Already licensed, or working on one specific thing? These lessons are built around a single goal.
Nervous about merging at 90 km/h? Dedicated highway sessions that make high-speed driving feel routine instead of daunting.
Licensed but out of practice, or anxious behind the wheel? Calm, unhurried lessons that rebuild your confidence at whatever pace suits you.
Transparent pricing. Pick the package that fits how much practice you need.
